source: the fomo altar remake (Reed's reference reel, fomo-DehudnaAmce)
note: The reel's dialogue stays word for word, by the same characters in the same order; nothing here needed a brand swap, so changed_lines is empty. The hustle montage (marked Replace) becomes the fomo grind-then-payoff montage with the real screens, and the live-action tag becomes fomo's end line. The two drafts differ only in how the hook plays (framing and the reaction), never in its words. A reselling reel would rewrite only its selling lines into trading lines, the same length, and list each in changed_lines.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Never say: guaranteed profit; can't lose
End line (every video ends on it, word for word): Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image: logo, colours and layout exact, numbers free:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:5 "Home (rich)" (mobile, home, portfolio) — required at: win
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>

<brief>Remake Reed's reference reel for fomo: the same story, shots and dialogue. The hustle montage becomes a wordless fomo trading montage with the real screens, keeping its length and match cuts. The live-action tag at the end becomes fomo's call to action. 9:16, about 45 s, stylized 3D animated.</brief>
<cast>
char:1 Nate, the teen groom
char:2 The bride
char:3 The rival, tall, long hair, navy suit
</cast>
<reference>
Story: A groom is dumped at the altar for a richer man, turns his heartbreak into a two-year hustle, and when his ex finds him again surrounded by admirers in a penthouse he tells her he's 'fully booked'.
Length: 45 s. Hook (0–4.88 s): Cold open mid-climax: 'I do' answered by a screamed 'HELL NO!' in extreme close-up, 6 shots in the first 2.3 s, ring thrown and bouncing on the floor, public betrayal ('I'm marrying him!') - instant conflict, no setup.
Beats:
- 0.0–4.9 s HOOK: altar humiliation. 'I do' -> bride screams 'HELL NO!', throws the ring, announces 'I'm marrying him!' -> groom 'What?!' (shock, humiliation)
- 4.9–9.3 s Abandonment: bride leaves with the rival in a luxury car; groom left alone at the altar, picks up the ring. (loneliness, defeat)
- 9.3–17.4 s Wound: puts on the ring, flashback 'I can't wait to spend forever with you', echoing 'forever with you' over his blank face. (heartbreak -> quiet resolve)
- 17.4–29.1 s MONTAGE (replace): wordless grind - laptop, camera, typing, packing orders across ever-bigger rooms/warehouses, walking warehouse aisles, then black suit, penthouse, skyline. (determination -> success)
- 29.1–31.1 s Time jump card: '2 YEARS LATER...' (anticipation)
- 31.1–34.1 s Reversal: ex and rival at a penthouse party spot him - 'Nate? Nate? Huh?!' - snap zoom on her shocked face. (shock, regret)
- 34.1–42.7 s Payoff: Nate by the glass, women gather around him, push-in to his smug smile: 'Sorry, I'm fully booked.' (triumph, smugness)
- 42.7–45.0 s Live-action tag: removed; the brand's end line goes here.
Shots (time, framing, camera, action, emotion, line):
1. 0.00–0.40 wide three-shot, eye level; static | Groom says his vows; bride turns away | groom earnest; bride irritated | groom (likely, mouth open, faces bride): "I do."
2. 0.40–0.82 extreme close-up on bride's face, slight low angle; quick push-in | Bride screams her refusal straight at camera | rage, contempt | bride: "HELL NO!"
3. 0.82–1.07 close-up, eye level; static | Reacts to the refusal | stunned, blank to shocked | bride (off-screen): "(NO! continues over)"
4. 1.07–1.17 close-up; static (6-frame flash shot) | Reaction insert | shocked
5. 1.17–1.55 extreme close-up insert on hands; static, shallow focus, flowers bg | Bride pulls engagement ring off and flicks it away | dismissive
6. 1.55–2.30 ground-level close-up (low angle) by groom's shoes; static | Ring falls and bounces on the marble floor, comes to rest | humiliation (implied)
7. 2.30–2.75 close-up; static | Mouth falls open | shock, hurt
8. 2.75–3.25 medium group shot; static | Guests gasp, hands over mouths | shock, scandal
9. 3.25–4.33 medium -> medium-full; fast whip-pan following bride's pointing arm down the aisle | Bride points at the rival standing among the guests; he smirks | bride defiant; rival smug | bride (off-screen arm): "I'm marrying him!"
10. 4.33–4.88 close-up; static | Grimaces, teeth clenched | disbelief, anguish | groom: "What?!"
11. 4.88–6.05 medium; handheld-feel follow | They walk off together toward a white luxury car; bride glances back | bride cold; rival pleased
12. 6.05–7.83 wide, eye level; static locked-off | Couple get in the car, it drives off, leaving the frame empty | abandonment
13. 7.83–9.30 wide, symmetrical, eye level; static; time passage via dissolves | He stands, bows his head, then kneels and picks up the ring | loneliness, defeat
14. 9.30–10.67 extreme close-up insert; static; light glint/sparkle on ring | Slips the gold band on his finger; it gleams | bittersweet
15. 10.67–14.05 medium two-shot, warm overexposed flashback; static, white-flash in, dissolve out | She looks up at him, then rests her head on his shoulder | tender, loving (memory) | bride (flashback, on screen): "I can't wait to spend forever with you."
16. 14.05–17.42 close-up, eye level; static / very slow push | Looks down at the ring on his hand | heartbroken, numb, then resolve | bride (voice-over memory echo): "Forever with you. (x3, echoing)"
17. 17.42–17.88 close-up insert; static | Hand rests on the laptop - decision moment | determination
18. 17.88–18.38 medium, front, low-key light; static | Typing on laptop | focused
19. 18.38–18.83 medium, front; static | Shoots camera straight into lens | focused
20. 18.83–19.33 POV over-the-shoulder on hands; static | Typing | focused
21. 19.33–19.58 medium; static | Taping a parcel | focused
22. 19.58–19.83 insert on monitor; static | Store website shown | progress
23. 19.83–20.22 medium; static, match cut | Taping, new location (bedroom) | grind
24. 20.22–20.47 medium; static, match cut | Taping a box, warmer room | grind
25. 20.47–20.92 medium; static, match cut | Handling stacks of mailers | grind
26. 20.92–21.55 medium; static, match cut (motion blur) | Taping box fast | grind
27. 21.55–21.75 medium; static, match cut | Taping / printing | grind
28. 21.75–22.13 medium; static, match cut | Fast hands over machine (blur) | grind
29. 22.13–22.33 medium; static, match cut | Taping large carton | grind
30. 22.33–22.67 medium; static, match cut | Taping box | grind
31. 22.67–22.92 medium; static, match cut | Taping box | grind
32. 22.92–23.17 medium; static, match cut | Taping box | grind / growth
33. 23.17–23.42 medium; static, match cut | Taping, orders on screen | grind
34. 23.42–23.72 full shot, front; walk toward camera, background swaps via match cuts | Walks toward camera | confident
35. 23.72–23.97 full shot, front; match cut (bg swap) | Walking | confident
36. 23.97–24.25 full shot, front; match cut (bg swap) | Walking | confident
37. 24.25–24.75 full shot, front; match cut (bg swap) | Walking | confident
38. 24.75–25.05 full shot, front; match cut (bg swap) | Walking | confident
39. 25.05–25.30 full shot, front; match cut (bg swap) | Walking | confident
40. 25.30–29.15 full -> wide, side then back; tracking shot following him | Pushes through glass door, crosses penthouse, stops at the balcony rail looking at the city | arrived, calm power
41. 29.15–31.08 black card; static | Typewriter title | suspense
42. 31.08–34.08 medium two-shot, eye level -> fast push to ECU; static then snap push-in on bride | She spots someone off-screen, does a double take; rival's jaw drops | recognition -> shock, regret | ex-bride: "Nate? Nate? ... Huh?!"
43. 34.08–42.67 wide -> medium close-up; static wide, then slow continuous push-in | Women cling to him; he smiles smugly, answers to camera | smug, unbothered, triumphant | Nate (mouth moves): "Sorry, I'm fully booked."
Shots 44–50 (42.67–45.02 s) are live action: always removed; that slot becomes the brand's end line.
Replace: the montage, 17.4–29.2 s (shots 17–40): make it a wordless fomo trading montage with the real fomo screens, shown exactly; keep its length, its match cuts (same pose, bigger world) and its end on the skyline arrival before the time jump.
</reference>

drafts.script:
SCENE 1 — EXT. FLORAL ALTAR BY THE OCEAN — DAY
NATE: I do.
BRIDE: HELL NO!
The bride throws the ring at Nate's feet and points at the rival in the front row.
BRIDE: I'm marrying him!
NATE: What?!
The bride drives off with the rival in a silver supercar. Nate stands alone at the altar and picks up the ring.
Nate slides the ring onto his finger. Flashback: the bride, smiling, holds his hands.
BRIDE: I can't wait to spend forever with you.
BRIDE (V.O.): Forever with you.
SCENE 2 — INT. NATE'S SMALL BEDROOM — NIGHT
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — a red day on Nate's phone
Wordless montage, Nate in every shot, same pose and a bigger world each cut: the grind first (a red day he shakes off, a small first win, another late night, a bigger win), then getting rich (Nate buys the beach house above the shore where the altar stood, Nate at the helm of his own boat past that shore, the crew of his own trading desk cheering him in, the sunset arrival on his deck).
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — the small first win, a phone ding
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance, on the phone in Nate's hand on his deck at sunset
SCENE 3 — INT. PENTHOUSE — NIGHT, TWO YEARS LATER
The bride and the rival spot Nate across the party.
BRIDE: Nate? Nate?
BRIDE: Huh?!
Women gather around Nate by the glass. He smiles.
NATE: Sorry, I'm fully booked.
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
